claims: Season 24 of American Idol premiered on ABC on January 26, 2026.
Season 24 of American Idol features judges Carrie Underwood, Lionel Richie, and Luke Bryan.
Ryan Seacrest is returning as host of Season 24 of American Idol.
The 2026 season of American Idol introduced an "Idol University" theme.
Hollywood Week of the 2026 season of American Idol was held in Nashville.
The Top 20 of the 2026 season of American Idol performed at Aulani in Hawaii.
Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie are joined by celebrity mentors including Keke Palmer and Brad Paisley for the Hawaii rounds of the 2026 season of American Idol.
Top 20 contestants of the 2026 season of American Idol include Jake Thistle, Kyndal Inskeep, Brooks Rosser, Hannah Harper, and Genevieve Heyward.
The Top 20/Hawaii Round of the 2026 season of American Idol was held at Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa in Ko Olina, Hawaii.
The dedicated American Idol app has been replaced.
Voting for American Idol now occurs via social media (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok) and online/text.
New episodes of American Idol air Mondays at 8/7c on ABC.
New episodes of American Idol stream on Hulu/Disney+.
Jake Thistle performed "The Power of Love".
Kyndal Inskeep is a Platinum Ticket holder.
Brooks Rosser is a Platinum Ticket holder.
The results of the first public vote, cutting the field from 20 to 14, will be revealed on March 30, 2026.
